## Use case / 使用场景

What task are you trying to solve? / 想解决什么任务？

## Proposed behavior / 期望行为

Describe inputs, outputs, and how success would be evaluated. / 说明输入、输出与验收方式。

## Boundaries / 边界

Does this affect S/F/C/P assets, framework execution, evaluation, or external resources? / 涉及资产、框架执行、评测还是外部资源？

## Evidence and alternatives / 证据与替代方案

Link relevant evidence and distinguish measured findings from hypotheses. / 链接相关证据，区分测量结果与假设。
